requiredScenarios: fixed decrease recalculates but never runs negative-shortage block
fixed increase runs same-year future ProductStock negative block
post-native ProductStock ROUND(Stock,3)<0 blocks -0.001 but allows raw sub-milli negative float noise

native null/missing returnCode or oResult rolls back
unfixed existing increase succeeds when all active ViewShipment baseline plus positive delta fits
unfixed existing increase returns STOCK_SHORTAGE when it does not fit

actions.name: EDIT_GRID_PHYSICAL_ROW_CARDINALITY
actions.shipmentDate: read-only-preserve; one visible editable row per SdateKey
actions.estimate: read-only-preserve; one visible editable deduction row per EstimateKey
actions.customerProdCost: read-only-preserve; deterministic latest row used when duplicate CustKey+ProdKey records exist
actions.rule: JOIN multiplication may not create multiple edit controls for the same physical PK. Rows with the same ProdKey/outDate but distinct SdateKey values remain separate and independently editable.

actions.name: DATE_DISTRIBUTION_INCREASE
actions.stock: unrounded active ViewShipment baseline (fixed+unfixed) plus same OrderYear/OrderWeek/ProdKey positive deltas is shortage-checked; decreases never offset increases. The shared three-decimal remain<0 guard is intentionally stricter than native integer ROUND(remain,0)<0, which can display a negative fractional box as zero. Product.Stock receives native CANCEL(old)+FIX(new) net delta only for fixed details; nonmanual StockHistory ChangeType=출고/ColumName=수량; scoped native calculation and current/future ProductStock negative check

actions.name: DATE_DISTRIBUTION_DECREASE
actions.stock: decrease skips shortage query; fixed Product.Stock and nonmanual 출고 history receive the signed net delta before scoped native calculation

crossYearFixture.description: 같은 OrderWeek가 다른 연도에 존재해도 SdateKey가 속한 ShipmentMaster의 OrderYear/OrderWeek·CustKey·ProdKey만 수정한다. SdateKey/수량/조회스냅샷 숫자는 빈값·boolean·접미문자를 허용하지 않는 엄격 Number 변환으로 검증한다. 삭제되지 않은 Product를 잠근 뒤 서버가 잠긴 ShipmentDate/ShipmentDetail로 실제 per-Sdetail delta를 다시 계산하며 클라이언트의 방향/확정 플래그를 신뢰하지 않는다. 가용재고는 native와 같은 이전 StockMaster 스냅샷+ViewWarehouse+StockType 이력에서, 동일 OrderYear/OrderWeek/ProdKey의 active ViewShipment 전체(확정·미확정) baseline과 양의 delta 합계를 뺀다. 감소는 증가와 상계하지 않는다. shared 3자리 remain<0 guard는 native 정수 반올림보다 엄격한 기존 웹 정책이며 -0.001/-0.4도 차단한다. 미확정 변경은 native calc을 호출하지 않는다. 확정 detail은 editGuard 없이는 legacy 저장을 허용하지 않으며 상태를 보존한 단일 트랜잭션에서 Product.Stock, 출고 StockHistory, ShipmentHistory, ShipmentDetail/ShipmentDate, product-scoped usp_StockCalculation, ProductStock 후속음수 검증, edit guard advance를 수행한다. GateCapability ProtocolVersion=2/IsReady=1과 idle singleton UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK,NOWAIT가 없으면 구버전 재시도 없이 차단한다. 확정 기준 총량/출고일 합계가 불완전하거나 StockType에 출고가 있으면 차단한다. OrderDetail과 농장배정 원장은 직접 변경하지 않으며 0 수량은 기존 purge 정책으로 ShipmentDetail/Date/Farm만 정리한다.
